key_findings: Two Tier A customer orders from Heartland Ag Equipment are at risk: SO-9012 (11 days late, $4,400 penalty exposure) and SO-9014 (8 days late, $3,200 penalty exposure), triggering critical severity.
CHI-DC will stockout on 2026-10-13, four days before the delayed shipment arrives on 2026-10-25, creating a 12-day inventory gap with only 900 units on hand against 70 units/day demand.
1,300 units are needed by 2026-10-09 to prevent all three at-risk orders from becoming late; this must arrive before the safety stock threshold is breached on 2026-10-09.
Total exposure is $22,400 in revenue at risk and $7,600 in penalty exposure across three orders; Heartland Ag Equipment accounts for $16,900 revenue and $7,600 penalty exposure.
Order SO-9011 (Tier B, 400 units, due 2026-10-03) ships on time and is not at risk; the disruption begins impacting orders due on or after 2026-10-09.
